title: Scene and cognitive video QA
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for multi-frame scene, transition, camera-zoom stability, reading-speed and split-attention cognitive-load, live desktop web-journey provenance, and widescreen lower-band frosted-caption geometry checks.
boundaries: Every multi-frame and cognitive QA report binds to the exact SHA-256 of the rendered video inspected.
Automated dwell, zoom-drift, cognitive-overlap, journey-provenance and caption-band checks catch structural defects; a human viewer still judges narrative clarity and visual craft.
Standard-library code executes locally without network calls, browser launches or remote model APIs.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and activates nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for multi-frame scene, transition, slide stability and cognitive-load video QA

value.lets_workers: Evaluate groups of frames across scene cuts for sub-second flash shots and ghosting text-over-text crossfades, block unmotivated Ken Burns zoom or pan drift on static slides and terminals, measure on-screen reading speed and split-attention prose conflicts against concurrent speech and captions, verify authentic desktop web-journey provenance from landing page through click navigation without submitting live forms, and check burned-in frosted-glass rounded-pill captions centered in the widescreen lower horizontal space.

flow.when: Check multi-frame shot durations and text-bearing transition overlaps across cuts.
Check static slides, cards, terminals and browser captures for unmotivated Ken Burns zoom or pan drift.
Check stage text dwell speed, disallowed must_read escapes and split-attention prose conflicts against speech.
Verify desktop website landing-and-click provenance plus centered frosted-glass lower-band captions.
Bind all five multi-frame and cognitive checks into one digest-pinned QA report.

value.worked_example: Synthetic three-shot explainer bundle recomputed by test_scene_cognitive_qa.py: catches a 0.80 s flash section card, an 8-frame text-over-text crossfade, a 2.8 percent Ken Burns zoom drift on a static hero slide, a 19-word stage sentence competing with unrelated narration, a cropped 980 px mid-page web card with no landing click, and an un-rounded native fullscreen caption box sitting 19 px off the lower-band vertical center.

nouns.title: Guardrail: bind every multi-frame and cognitive QA report to the exact video SHA-256
nouns.category_reason: Prevents stale storyboard or pre-caption measurements from certifying a re-encoded video.

value.rule: Every scene, transition, camera-stability and caption-band measurement names the 64-hex SHA-256 of the exact encoded MP4 inspected.
value.how_it_is_checked: compile_scene_cognitive_report and template.scene-cognitive-qa-report enforce a 64-hex media_sha256.

nouns.title: Guardrail: live website recordings show landing and typing without ever submitting synthetic forms
nouns.category_reason: Prevents demo captures from polluting live intake queues.

value.rule: Website recordings navigate from the real landing page to the target route and type synthetic text into inputs for illustration only, clearing without submitting.
value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_live_web_journey_provenance emits a blocker finding if form_submitted is true.

nouns.title: Guardrail: keep static slides, typographic cards and terminals locked at 1:1 scale unless zooming to a named focal target
nouns.category_reason: Eliminates unmotivated Ken Burns scale drift that softens rasterized text.

value.rule: Static slides, section cards, typographic quotes, terminals and full-window browser captures hold scale=1.000 and 0 px pan drift unless an explicit focal target justifies a camera move.
value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_camera_and_slide_stability flags scale drift >= 0.003 or pan drift > 2.0 px on static scene kinds without has_focal_target.

verbs.title: Audit multi-frame shot dwell and text-bearing transition overlaps
verbs.summary: Check shot durations across scene cuts for flash cards shorter than 1.6 s and flag crossfades longer than 4 frames between text-bearing shots.
verbs.outcome: Shot cadence statistics, flash-shot findings and ghosting transition findings.

slots.name: shot_and_transition_plan
slots.description: Pin of the storyboard shot spans and cut/crossfade list.

network: Reads local storyboard JSON and frame spans only.
steps: Evaluate every shot window against min_shot_s (1.60 s) and warn_text_shot_s (2.00 s).
Flag crossfade or dissolve transitions exceeding 4 frames when both adjacent shots display text.

acceptance.check: evaluate_shot_dwell_and_transitions reproduces min_shot_s, flash_shots and ghost_transitions.

verbs.title: Audit static slides, cards and terminals for unmotivated Ken Burns zoom or pan drift
verbs.summary: Inspect multi-frame scale and translation trajectories on static slides, typographic cards, section cards, terminals and browser captures, flagging drift when no focal target is declared.
verbs.outcome: Per-scene scale and translation drift counts and findings.

slots.name: scene_camera_tracks
slots.description: Pin of measured or authored multi-frame camera scale and pan samples.

network: Reads local camera trajectory observations without network calls.
steps: Compute scale range and Euclidean translation drift across each scene's multi-frame samples.
Flag static scene kinds without has_focal_target whose scale drifts >= 0.003 or pan drifts > 2.0 px.

verbs.title: Audit on-screen reading speed and split-attention prose conflicts against narration
verbs.summary: Verify every stage text span stays up for at least 0.45 s plus words/3.5, reject must_read=False escapes on prose >= 6 words, and flag >= 12-word stage sentences that diverge lexically from concurrent speech.
verbs.outcome: Unreadable item count, cognitive conflict count, peak words-per-second and timestamped findings.

slots.name: stage_text_and_speech
slots.description: Pin of on-screen text items and timed speech/caption cues.

network: Evaluates local text spans and WebVTT/narration cues.
steps: Check every stage text item for positive duration, disallowed must_read=False prose escapes, and dwell >= 0.45 + words/3.5 s.
Compute content-word overlap between >= 12-word stage prose and overlapping narration cues, flagging overlap < 0.35.

verbs.title: Audit desktop website click-through provenance and widescreen frosted-caption geometry
verbs.summary: Verify web captures show >= 1280 px desktop browser chrome, landing-page entry and click navigation without live form submission, and check burned-in frosted-glass captions centered at (960, 1006) in the y=932..1080 lower band.
verbs.outcome: Web-journey provenance findings, caption centroid offsets and line-break hygiene findings.

slots.name: journeys_and_caption_band
slots.description: Pin of recorded web journeys, lower-band caption geometry and wrapped cues.

network: Inspects local capture metadata and rendered caption geometry.
steps: Run evaluate_live_web_journey_provenance to verify >= 1280 px viewport, browser chrome, homepage-to-route click navigation and form_submitted == False.
Run evaluate_frosted_caption_geometry to verify burned-in frosted-glass rounded pills centered at (960, 1006) +/- 3 px with zero native fullscreen ::cue leak and zero 1-word orphans.

acceptance.check: evaluate_live_web_journey_provenance and evaluate_frosted_caption_geometry reproduce unconvincing_journeys and centroid offsets.

verbs.title: Compile the consolidated multi-frame scene and cognitive video QA report
verbs.summary: Combine shot dwell, transition ghosting, static-slide zoom stability, reading-speed and split-attention load, web-journey provenance and frosted-caption geometry into one digest-pinned QA report.
verbs.outcome: A conforming scene-cognitive QA report bound to media_sha256.
